content.description: Illustration showing removal of back-up light switch, speedometer driven gear, shift lever retainer and restrict pins from transmission

items: REMOVE BACK-UP LIGHT SWITCH, SPEEDOMETER DRIVEN GEAR, SHIFT LEVER RETAINER AND RESTRICT PINS

content.description: Illustration showing removal of clutch housing from transmission case

items: REMOVE CLUTCH HOUSING FROM TRANSMISSION CASE

content.description: Illustration showing removal of extension housing with nine bolts and shift lever housing set bolt visible

sub_items.label: (a)
sub_items.text: Remove the shift lever housing set bolt.

sub_items.label: (c)
sub_items.text: Using a plastic hammer, tap the extension housing.

sub_items.label: (d)
sub_items.text: Disengage the shift and select lever from the shift head.

content.text: NOTE: Leave the gasket attached to the intermediate plate.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of front bearing retainer and bearing snap rings

items: REMOVE FRONT BEARING RETAINER AND BEARING SNAP RINGS

content.description: Illustration showing separation of intermediate plate from transmission case using a plastic hammer

items.main: SEPARATE INTERMEDIATE PLATE FROM TRANSMISSION CASE

sub_items.label: (a)
sub_items.text: Using a plastic hammer, carefully tap the transmission case.

sub_items.label: (b)
sub_items.text: Pull the transmission case from the intermediate plate.

content.text: NOTE: Leave the gasket attached to the intermediate plate.
